cases.caption: A long jumper demonstrates a flawed technique, resulting in a short distance and an unbalanced landing.
A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor.
A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side.
Multiple ping pong balls are shown, illustrating different stages of a rally.
A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat.
A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
A person on a unicycle stops abruptly, putting a foot down to maintain balance before continuing.
A player hits the ball off the side of the mallet, resulting in an unexpected trajectory.
A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
Multiple water balloons are tossed upwards, simultaneously bursting in the air in a small arc.
A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
A bulldozer pulls a heavy load attached with a chain, moving it across the ground.
Javelin with a damaged tip is thrown; it wobbles in flight and lands off-target.
A time-lapse showing the process of someone tying a bow tie, quickly showing the steps in sequence.
A skateboarder rolls along a smooth concrete path, maintaining a steady pace.
A luger's sled impacts a small snowbank at the edge of the track, causing a slight spray of snow.
A surfer falls off their board, colliding briefly with another surfer, before swimming away.
A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
A person skillfully tosses several coins in the air, catching them one by one.
A player hits a forehand drive, the ball spinning rapidly as it crosses the net.
Someone throws a snowball into the air, it breaks apart during flight.
A tightly folded parachute is unfolded, revealing its vibrant colors and intricate design.
A player uses a quick set to spike the ball, driving it downward at a steep angle.
A player jumps high to block a spike, their hands impacting the ball forcefully, sending it back across the net.
A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
A woodcutter with a long handled axe chops down a thick tree in a forest.
A slow-motion view of the jump showing leg extension and body position.
A competitor approaches the runway, accelerates, jumps, and lands with their legs spread wide.
A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
A wedge is driven into a log using a sledgehammer, splitting the log cleanly apart.

Poi are swung against a soft surface, making a thudding sound (NOTE: This prompt includes sound, but it's included to illustrate the effect of the action, not to describe it in detail.  The focus is still on the visible impact).
